notes.title: GRAPHICS UPDATE
notes.content:
The graphics have been updated replacing the old parallax background with new more stylised mountains.(Now that I can compare, they old ones look dumb lol)

Even more important than that, I have added new selectable color palettes, the old one "COLODORE (16 COL)" is still present as second option , but the new default one "DOC BRINGER (32 COL)" makes the game looks 200% better,, here a list of all of them:

- DOC BRINGER (32 colours): Based on Dawn Bringer's 32 color palette, it has been modified to match better the color reduction algorithm on the Darsalon render pipeline.

- COLODORE (16 colours):  A replica of the famous Commodore 64 colours.

- SPECCYISH (32 colours): Based on the basic ZX Spectrum colours but with 16 intermediate colours.

- MAG & YELLOW (8 Colours): Custom palette for a minimalistic stylised look.

- GREEN & SOFT PINK (8 Colours): Custom palette for a minimalistic stylised look.

- CGAISH (8 Colours): Based on the classic CGA palette but with 4 intermediate colours and less saturated so you don't have to rip your eyes out.

Dithering values have been adjusted for each one.
